extension.summary: FenSkeleton - lean multi-debrid resolver for TMDbHelper
extension.description: Fast, minimal debrid resolver built on the stable v0.1.10 engine. Pairs with TMDbHelper for browsing. Supports Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox and Easynews. External scraper modules such as CocoScrapers and Magneto are supported. Works with Fen-Mage skin.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any content. For personal use with content you have the right to access only.
extension.news: v0.0.21 - Local Watch State foundation: quietly syncs existing Trakt cache into a local watch-state database in the background, shows a small Trakt synced notification, and prepares for future Simkl/local provider support without remote writes. v0.0.20 - Trakt safe repair: uses sync/watched/shows with extended=progress, silently self-heals missing TV watched data, protects local watched status from empty remote pulls, and keeps a manual Trakt Repair Sync button for emergencies. v0.0.15 - Easynews reliability and settings cleanup: retry failed Easynews requests once, validate the first 1 MB before playback, allow failed links to fall through to the next resolve attempt, keep external scraper selection neutral until configured, and remove the duplicate RPDB settings block. v0.0.13 - Android safety fix: directory refreshes and stale widget paths can no longer trigger Random Next Up playback; playback now uses a separate explicit click-only route. v0.0.3 - Clean video-addon package: removed embedded skin bundle; fixed Random Next Episodes to actually shuffle Next Up; retained TorBox device-code auth and icon set. v0.0.2 - v1 base checkpoint: TorBox device-code auth retained; Random Next Episodes route added; updated icon set retained. v0.0.1 - Initial public release.
